question: Which supported acknowledgement-selection contract, if any, should OpenClaw provide across its bundled channels: retain one fixed value, add a deterministic/configured pool, or allow a model-driven pre-ack path?
rationale: This choice sets a compatibility-sensitive public configuration contract and determines whether acknowledgements remain immediate and predictable or depend on additional model work.

options.title: Add a deterministic configured pool
options.body: Preserve the existing singular setting and, in a sponsored follow-up, define an ordered or randomized pool with explicit per-channel validation and fallback behavior.

options.title: Keep the fixed reaction contract
options.body: Decline additional core configuration and leave per-message variation to explicit channel message-tool reactions.

options.title: Explore model-driven acknowledgements
options.body: Design a separate pre-ack decision lifecycle only if maintainers accept its latency, cost, and observability implications.

recommendation.title: Add a deterministic configured pool
recommendation.body: Preserve the existing singular setting and, in a sponsored follow-up, define an ordered or randomized pool with explicit per-channel validation and fallback behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history most directly connects this person to the shared acknowledgement configuration and runtime surface.
